card.name: Linking words before a named source
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, by, a, when) that come right before the naming of a biological source or cause, such as a beetle, plant, bacterium or jellyfish. Seen in explanatory text about where something comes from or what causes a condition.

modes.label: Origin of a substance
modes.description: Linking word after 'derived from' or 'leaves' that leads into the organism a product comes from.
modes.example: Derived from<< the>> ground bodies of female cochineal beet

modes.label: Cause of a disease
modes.description: Linking word after 'caused by', 'stung by' or 'due to' that leads into the causative agent.
modes.example: In dogs, the disease is caused by<< a>> bacterium named Brucella canis

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the text names the creature or agent that a substance or illness comes from.
